answer: Put a tiny kernel of verified code at the heart of every identity: each agent must run its epoch claim through that kernel, which stamps the claim with a hardware-bound proof before it leaves the mesa of the local network. A willow of auditors re-runs a random sample of stamped claims, and any stamp whose work cannot be reproduced burns the identity's bond. Cloning the kernel is useless without the hardware proof, so a sybil farmer must buy one real device per fake while one honest agent stamps once, cheaply.
